messages.text: Heads up, got a client looking to sell 400k of a mid-cap industrial. ADV is like 1.8M so this is not small. Need a plan before I give them any color.
That's over 20% of ADV. I'd not touch it in the open book all at once. Is there a natural on the other side or are we working it?
No natural yet. Client is price sensitive, wants to be done by close but says they'll stretch to Monday if the footprint is ugly.
Pulled the intraday volume curve for the name. Roughly 55% of the day's volume still ahead of us. At 15% participation we'd finish around 230k by the close, so not the full size today.
Agree. I'd run a VWAP-ish schedule with a hard limit and put 100k into the dark pools first. Sean, what's the expected impact at 15%?
Model says about 22 bps on the slice at 15%, closer to 35 bps if we push to 25%. Spread is wide too, so the slippage estimate is probably light.
I can shop it to a couple of buy-side axes I know. Two of them were long-biased in that sector last week. Want me to go out with IOIs?
Yes please, Jess, but keep it vague. No size, no side on anything that prints. Just see who has interest.
Agree, info leakage is the biggest risk here. One slip and the whole street front-runs us.
I'll stage the parent order in OMS now. Limit 41.10, 15% POV, dark-first routing. Travis, do you want to own the child orders or leave it on algo?
I'll take it manually for the first hour, then flip to algo if prints look clean. Tag it to me.
Done. Parent is live in OMS, should show on TradeBlotter in a minute. Let me know if the fill average looks off.
Quick check: TradeBlotter is showing 38k filled at 41.14, but OMS says 41k. Looks like a lag on the blotter side.
Yeah, I see it. OMS is right, I have the 41k on my screen. Blotter refresh is probably just slow. Ignore it for now.
One axis came back. They'd take 60k at 41.05 if we can print it as a cross. Not great, but it's real size. Thoughts?
Take it. 60k off the market is worth a few cents. Travis, pause the algo until the cross prints so we don't overlap.
